1 (Currently amended): A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: in a housing, the housing disposed between a pair of studs of the wall, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; and a fan, wherein the studs are spaced __at least__ sixteen inches on center.

2 (Currently amended): The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced __no more than__ twenty-four inches on center.

4 (Currently amended): The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad, and at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation.

6 (Currently amended): The cooling system of claim 5, wherein the fan causes the cooled air to flow through an opening __in the housing__.

11 (Currently amended): The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing includes a front cover __that is removable__.

13 (Currently amended): The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the wall is a load-bearing wall __that supports the housing__.

15 (Currently amended): A cooling system kit, comprising: the cooling system of claim 1; mounting elements; and a ventilation grill __for directing airflow__. 

17 (Currently amended): A cooling system, comprising: a cooling system installable within a structure wall, the cooling system comprising a housing, a water reservoir, a pump, a pad, a water distributor, a motor, and a fan, wherein the cooling system is configured to cool an indoor area. 

18 (Currently amended): The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the cooling system is configured to be placed between wall studs spaced __at least__ sixteen inches on center.
